schema: bytes32 tokenCommitment,bytes32 claimCommitment,bytes32 lotCommitment,bytes32 witnessProductionCommitment,bytes32 relationCommitment,uint8 articulation
chainRule: Each later claim uses EAS refUID to reference the attestation it answers; multiple prerequisites are committed in relationCommitment or a later array-bearing schema.
authorityRule: An EAS attestation proves which account made which structured claim. It does not prove truth, successful execution, customer acceptance, title, fungibility, or price.
accountRule: The sovereign EnterpriseAccount executes IEAS.attest, so EAS records the enterprise account as attester; its controller key is custody authority and never substitutes as the protocol-level claimant.
storageRule: Only fixed-size commitments and EAS lifecycle fields are onchain. Full token/claim lots, context, derivations, and evidence remain in their owning settlements.
paymentRule: The adapter fixes resolver value to zero and performs no token transfer, custody, x402 settlement, or monetary claim.
